question: Which beings are proclaimed as bearing the supreme mark of brahma and others and having red color?
premises: Brahma and others have a supreme mark.
Those bearing that mark are proclaimed.
inference: The red-colored mark-bearers are the proclaimed associates of brahma and others.
uncertainties: Fused token cihnaṃdhārayaṃtyaḥprakīrtitāḥ requires sandhi parsing; exact grammatical agreement uncertain.
plain_english: Those proclaimed as bearing the supreme mark of brahma and the rest are red-colored.
